threshold_note: Objective times are wiki facts (docs/strategy/midgame-macro.md). Distances are minimap fractions (own base at the bottom; y < enemy_half_y is the enemy half). Lead, fed and Midboss-taker thresholds were tuned on rec13 (lead +46k thrown, Infernus 1.3x the rest of his team from 30:27, Midboss kills 29:52 by us and 39:38 by them) and checked for false calls on rec12 / rec11 / rec8.
roles_note: Your hero's job in a plan, by role. Heroes not listed use 'default'.

long_range.urn: hold back and Owl their carrier
long_range.siege: shoot from max range behind the troopers
long_range.midboss: shoot from the pit edge, Snare the entrance

default.urn: stay with the carrier and peel
default.siege: hit it while the troopers tank
default.midboss: stay in the pit with the team

jobs_sources.excerpt: Guided Owl can be used as a targeted, long-range stun that is capable of interrupting hard-to-reach channeled ults from behind cover
Placing a snare in narrow areas where enemies are likely to ambush from (or escape to) can force them to either be hit by the snare or take a less ideal path.
so heroes must do the work while troopers tank

threats_note: Named threat calls: the enemy hero, what makes it dangerous, and what you do. 'reach' = 'close' (called only when the hero is seen near you) or 'any' (also when it went missing while you are forward). Speech is '{hero} {state}: {danger}. {counter}.' and must stay within 15 words.

threats.danger: his Shoulder Charge stuns on walls

sources.excerpt: Charge forward, pulling enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies stun.

counter.long_range: walk behind a teammate, not on ziplines

sources.excerpt: Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize.

threats.danger: her Essence Bomb blows after arming

sources.excerpt: Sacrifice some of your health to launch a bomb that deals damage after a brief arm time.

counter.long_range: max range and break line of sight

sources.excerpt: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing spirit damage over time.

threats.danger: his mark reaches across the map

sources.excerpt: Stalker's Mark has no range limit, allowing Drifter to hit enemies across the entire map.

threats.danger: his aura ramps up within 8 meters

sources.excerpt: The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

counter.long_range: stay with your team, Snare her landing

sources.excerpt: eliminates solitary enemies swiftly.

threats.danger: Frost Grenade slows you for a dive

sources.excerpt: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.

cards.speech: Urn in {secs} on {lane} side: we contest it together. You {job}.{walk}
cards.rationale: The urn spawn alternates sides and is contested by both teams; the plan names the side and the player's job before it lands.

sources.excerpt: Urn: first at 10:00 (descends 12.5s), then every 5 min, alternates Yellow(York)/Green(Greenwich), first always Yellow.
Before any group objective: check which teammates are near, ults ready, waves cleared; assign simple jobs; hold an escape path

cards.speech: Urn in {secs} on {lane} side, {count} of them dead: grab it before they're back.{walk}
cards.rationale: With enemies dead the urn is uncontested; take it while the respawn timers run.

sources.excerpt: Urn: first at 10:00 (descends 12.5s), then every 5 min, alternates Yellow(York)/Green(Greenwich), first always Yellow.
Decision: take urn when the enemy cannot reach the delivery side

cards.speech: Urn in {secs}, but we're {count} down: skip it and shove your wave.
cards.rationale: A short-handed team loses the contest; the wave is guaranteed value.

sources.section: ## 7. Closing checklist ([INFERENCE] assembled from wiki mechanics)
sources.excerpt: Retreat/reset if two or more of your team are dead and the enemy is full.

cards.speech: Power-ups spawn in {secs} seconds. Shove your wave first, then take the nearest one.
cards.rationale: The first power-ups come at 5:00; leaving lane after securing the wave costs no trooper souls.

sources.excerpt: Powerups 2 locations from 5:00, every 5 min; replace if uncollected.
leave lane right after securing a wave; return before the next arrives.

cards.speech: Guardians go weak at 12:00. Shove {lane} and take its Guardian with your laner.
cards.rationale: The resistance drop is a fixed time; arriving with the wave on the Guardian converts it.

sources.excerpt: Guardians lose all damage resistance at 12:00; Walkers at 18:00.

cards.speech: Walkers go weak at 18:00. We shove {lane} into its Walker; you {job}.
cards.rationale: Walkers become killable at 18:00; troopers must tank, so the wave goes first.

sources.excerpt: Guardians lose all damage resistance at 12:00; Walkers at 18:00.
so heroes must do the work while troopers tank

cards.speech: {count} of them dead for {secs} seconds: Midboss now, together. You {job}.
cards.rationale: Enemies dead long enough to kill the boss and hold the Rejuvenator crystal.

sources.excerpt: Boss decision checklist: all enemies visible or dead? Team grouped? Ults available?
On kill: 3000 +50/min souls split equally, 2 permanent buffs per player, Rejuvenator drops (6s descent).

cards.speech: Midboss back in {secs} seconds: clear your wave, group mid; you {job}.
cards.rationale: Respawn time follows the wiki schedule from the observed kill.

sources.excerpt: Mid-Boss: now spawned at game start (update 2026-05-22). Respawns 7 min after first death, 6 after second, 5 afterward.

cards.speech: Our lead dropped from {peak}k to {now}k. No fights in their base: farm and group.
cards.rationale: A shrinking lead late is the throw pattern: stop taking coin-flip fights.

sources.excerpt: Don't throw a won game by chasing one last kill into the enemy base - take the objective, then reset.
skip the coin-flip fight

cards.speech: They took Midboss: Rejuvenator for three minutes. Don't fight them now; defend together under our structures.
cards.rationale: Rejuvenator credits revive them in place for 3 minutes; fights in that window are lost.

sources.excerpt: Rejuvenator drops after Midboss dies. Credits last 3 minutes (reduced from 4).

cards.speech: We're {lead}k up but {hero} is their whole game. No fights in their base without Rejuvenator.
cards.rationale: One enemy far above his team decides fights; the lead is protected by not fighting him on his terms.

sources.excerpt: Don't throw a won game by chasing one last kill into the enemy base - take the objective, then reset.
Rejuvenator drops after Midboss dies. Credits last 3 minutes (reduced from 4).

cards.speech: {hero} is fed at {nw}k, far above his team. Fight him only together, never alone.
cards.rationale: A fed enemy wins one-on-ones; numbers are the answer.

sources.excerpt: A fight entered with team split or a teammate still walking from base is usually lost (metabot).

cards.speech: Fight's won, but you're at {pct}%. Back off and heal, then {objective} together.
cards.rationale: After a won fight the objective waits; dying at low health on a structure gives the fight back.

sources.excerpt: after the objective, spend souls and reset (deadlockatlas)
Don't throw a won game by chasing one last kill into the enemy base - take the objective, then reset.
Standing in base will quickly regenerate the player's health
